name: real_assamese_nllb_to_qwen_ollama
description: REAL MODELS, NO MOCKS. Sender is NLLB-200-distilled-600M loaded in-process (it genuinely covers Assamese). Receiver is Qwen2.5 7B served by a local Ollama daemon, so the 7B weights never enter this process. Requires: ollama serve && ollama pull qwen2.5:7b-instruct. The promotion policy is left at its strict default because nothing here is mocked.
